visual_logic: Captures the unique dual-function jaw layout using the wide open-mouth format, showcasing the toothless upturned front tip with crushing knobs at the back.
prompt: High-fidelity 3D asset of the open jaws of a Dsungaripterus, viewed from a three quarter view perspective to display the specialized dental zoning, rendered in a 3D animated feature film aesthetic with soft, stylized edges. The jaws open wide around an empty mouth cavity. The absolute front tip of the beak is completely toothless, smooth, and curves sharply upward like sturdy tweezers, transitioning midway along the outer margins into wide, low, rounded knob-like ivory crushing teeth. At the base of the jaw, the stylized, rugged sandy-gold head features large, warm, highly expressive character eyes. The specimen is perfectly centered in a 1:1 square composition, keeping a strict 25% negative space safety margin. Placed flat against a neutral, 50% grey studio floor plane with high-contrast contact shadows. Illuminated by soft studio lighting with ambient occlusion to define the transition from tweezer tip to crushing pads.
